# Senai Technology

> Creative technology studio building AI-powered websites, mobile apps, brand identity, and interactive experiences.

## About

Senai Technology is a creative technology studio with headquarters in Briarcliff Manor, New York, and roots in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We are a Slotted LLC company founded by Senai Motley.

## Services

We offer six core services:

### 1. AI-built websites & web apps
Fast, beautiful sites and web apps built with AI-accelerated workflows — from launch pages to booking flows and full product dashboards.
- Marketing sites
- Web applications
- E-commerce platforms

### 2. Mobile apps
iOS and Android apps from first prototype to App Store release. Native feel, real-world tested — we've shipped our own.
- iOS development
- Android development
- Prototyping

### 3. Brand identity & AI visuals
Names, logos, type and colour systems, plus art-directed AI imagery that still looks unmistakably like you.
- Brand identity design
- Art direction
- AI-generated imagery

### 4. Video & motion
Launch films, social loops, product motion and 3D — cinematic content made for the feed and the big screen.
- Motion design
- 3D animation
- Social media content

### 5. AI tools for businesses
Chatbots, booking assistants and quiet automations that answer customers, fill calendars and give your team hours back.
- Chatbots
- Booking assistants
- Business automation

### 6. Interactive & event experiences
Installations, live visuals and playful web toys for launches, venues and performances — things people want to touch.
- Interactive installations
- Live visuals
- Event experiences

## Portfolio

### OpenSlot (Shipped)
Mobile app for iOS - An event & performance app for iPhone. Venues host open mics and DJ nights in minutes; performers discover comedy, music, poetry and DJ slots nearby and reserve with one tap. Designed and built by Senai Motley; available on the App Store.
Link: https://openslot.me

### Concept Projects
- **Greenline Landscaping**: Website for local service - A fast, photo-led site with instant quote requests and seasonal service pages for a Hudson Valley landscaper.
- **Buna & Butter**: Pastry shop website - A warm, editorial bakery site with pre-orders, a daily-bake menu and a nod to Ethiopian coffee ceremony.
- **Slot**: AI booking assistant - A friendly assistant that answers questions, checks availability and books appointments over web chat and SMS.

## Technology Stack

We specialize in:
- React and modern web frameworks
- Three.js for 3D experiences
- AI/ML integration
- Mobile development (iOS/Android)
- Motion design and animation
